verdict.rationale: An image-processing tool could plausibly ship AI-driven insights or suggestions about a user's images, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only deterministic operations: identification of format and attributes, edge detection, perceptual hashing and histogram equalization. None of these are AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
